title: DOMUS ABSCONDITA
description:
Step into the shoes of a private investigator drawn to an eerie family Manor, a sprawling estate shrouded in mystery and malevolence. Hired to uncover the truth behind a string of unexplained disappearances and disturbing phenomena, you must navigate the mansion's dark corridors, hidden passages, and ominous rooms. As you delve deeper, the line between reality and the supernatural blurs. Each clue unravels a piece of the manor's grim history, revealing restless spirits, malevolent entities, and ancient waygates.

With limited resources and mounting terror, you must solve intricate and unique puzzles and outsmart the sinister forces that seek to claim your soul. 
Will you have what it takes to uncover the truth?THANK YOU FOR YOUR SUPPORT!

WARNING
This game contains flashing lights that may make it unsuitable for people with photosensitive epilepsy or other photosensitive conditions. 
Player discretion is advised.
description_short: DOMUS ABSCONDITA is single player horror and mystery adventure. Step into the shoes of a private investigator and try to uncover all the secrets of the Manor. Will you escape with the truth, or will you become another lost soul within its haunted halls?
